test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some telephones are mobiles.

All mobiles are tablets.

Some tablets are laptops.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some mobiles are laptops.

II. All telephones are tablets.

III. Some telephones are tablets.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/059fd635f0c0cd9a7d2fbba0e603bd44ee23c4bff9f1a6aa0b0a62528c58647f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some mobiles are laptops → Does not follow → (As, all mobiles are tablets and some tablets are laptops, So some mobile are laptop is possible but not definite true)

II. All telephones are tablets → Does not follow → (As, some telephones are mobiles, all mobiles are tablets and some tablets are laptops. So, all telephone being tablets are possibility but not definite true)

III. Some telephones are tablets → Follow → (As, some telephones are mobiles and all mobiles are tablets. So, some telephone are tablets are definite true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**
